pipeline_alias: Tomoro ColQwen3-4B + BM25 + doc MaxP + zerank-2
description: Open-weight pipeline without generative models. TomoroAI/tomoro-colqwen3-embed-4b scores page images with late-interaction MaxSim. When the corpus language (detected from the page markdown) is the query language, a BM25 score on the page markdown is added (z(MaxSim) + 0.1 z(BM25)). Pages are then boosted by their document's best page score (z(page) + 2 z(max page score of the same document)). The document comes from the corpus doc_id column, used only as a grouping key: its text is never given to a model. The top 50 pages are reranked by zeroentropy/zerank-2 on the page markdown (first 8,000 characters), fused as z(first stage) + 4 z(zerank-2 logit). The weights (0.1, 2, 4) were fixed before this evaluation and are the same for every dataset.

hardware_information.notes: Queries run one at a time. Indexing embeds pages on both GPUs. In search, queries are embedded on GPU 0, then the retriever is unloaded and one zerank-2 copy is loaded per GPU (both models do not fit on one 16 GB T4; the reranker loading time is included in the search time). The 50 candidates of each query are split across the 2 GPUs. Models in fp16 with SDPA attention (no flash-attention on T4).

nodes.description: Late-interaction (MaxSim) retrieval over multi-vector page image embeddings built in index() (max 1280 visual tokens per page).
BM25 (rank-bm25, Okapi) on page markdown. Used only when the detected corpus language equals the query language.
z(MaxSim) + 0.1 z(BM25), then page score + 2 x (z-scored best page score of the same document, grouped by doc_id). No model call.
Cross-encoder on (query, page markdown truncated to 8,000 characters) for the top 50 pages; raw logits fused as z(first stage) + 4 z(logit). Pages 51-100 keep the first-stage order.

edges.description: BM25 score of every page (same-language corpora only).
Top 50 pages with their first-stage scores.
